label: DS-35 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the single-gene DefensePredictor-discovered system 35 locus cataloged as working transcriptional unit RED5 and whose plasmid expression in E. coli MG1655 reduced bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from the RED5 source working identifier, the individual DS-35 gene or protein, the DS-35 HMM profile row, cloned-transcriptional-unit plaquing assays, PDDEXK HHpred-domain annotations, the absent DS-35 rule-level DefenseFinder model, unresolved DS-35 component activity and phage readouts, and other DefensePredictor-discovered or phage-defense systems.
